name: resumeai-personal
description: ResumeAI - AI-powered resume website with chatbot and job fit assessment

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -r ../frontend/dist/. dist/public/
